content:
**Priority handoff for cold agents (#688)**

Re-derived brain's state against main 3eff9af after 17 PRs merged in two days, and wrote docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md so a cold agent can start without a chat window.

Measured rather than inferred: publish.yml has 0 runs and @logikas/brain returns 404 against a 200 control, so #435 has not moved in three snapshots. A Status-line count over all 30 signed ADRs returns exactly one malformed file, adr-0029 — correcting #676's rate from 2 of 30 to 1 of 30, because ADR-0031 was repaired by revert + re-promote after #676 was written.

Verified promote's two routes separately. Route A is closed: running the new promote-guards against brain-drafts/adr-0023-sdd-role-port.md returns ok:false with a diagnosis naming the fix, where the same draft on the previous main produced a signed artefact with two Status lines and no refusal. Route B is still open, and an agent may not repair it — brain/project/decisions/** is Tier 3.

The document states its own expiry conditions before its content, with the command that re-derives each one. A handoff that cannot tell its reader it has gone stale is evidence-reader-empty-on-failure in prose, which is the class the seven tickets opened on 2026-08-15 all describe.

Commit carries no AI-attribution trailer, per ADR-0031 and agent-authorities Tier 3, against a harness default that mandates the opposite — which is the conflict ADR-0031 exists to have already decided.
